visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back wears a pink ribbed halter top and light beige shorts. She sits cross-legged on a wooden floor in a minimalist studio setting. She speaks enthusiastically to the camera, using expressive hand gestures to introduce the topic of Yin Yoga. (2) A second woman, a yoga teacher, appears wearing a white sports bra and light grey shorts. Both women smile warmly and wave simultaneously towards the lens. The background is a clean, neutral grey wall with soft, even studio lighting highlighting their physical forms and expressions. (3) The scene transitions to include white graphic overlays titled "五臟狀態自我檢測表" featuring a radar chart. The women discuss the chart's contents, which categorize emotional and physical health markers in Traditional Chinese text, while sitting together on the wooden floor. (4) The teacher demonstrates a simple health technique by placing her hands on her lower abdomen. The host follows her lead, both moving their hands in a circular motion around the navel. Their facial expressions are focused yet relaxed as they demonstrate the activity. (5) The host expresses difficulty with a leg-crossing pose, humorously clutching her ankles and making exaggerated faces. The teacher then guides her through a forward-folding stretch. A split-screen effect occasionally shows both women simultaneously as they perform the deep stretching movements together. (6) Returning to a single full shot, they sit side-by-side discussing the benefits of the course. The host points toward an off-screen link while summarizing the promotional details. Finally, they clap hands and wave goodbye, concluding the video in a friendly manner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic female voice introduces the video over a light, mid-tempo acoustic pop background music track. The BPM is approximately 115. Her tone is welcoming and bright, exhibiting clear articulation and expressive pitch contours typical of lifestyle vlogging. (2) A second female voice, identified as the teacher, enters with a high-pitched, enthusiastic greeting. A subtle 'bubble pop' sound effect highlights their initial interaction. The background music maintains a consistent, upbeat rhythmic floor with clean guitar and electronic percussion layers. (3) As the discussion moves to the health checklist, a digital 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of on-screen graphics. The teacher’s voice adopts a more instructional, professional tone while remaining friendly, explaining the radar chart's significance. (4) During the demonstration of belly massage, the audio captures slight rustling noises from their clothing. The host makes an exaggerated vocal sound followed by a humorous cartoonish pop effect to simulate a physical reaction, keeping the tone lighthearted. (5) The host's voice takes on a comical, strained quality as she mentions her difficulty with leg flexibility, contrasted by the teacher's warm and encouraging responses. The background music remains steady, supporting the positive atmosphere during the deep stretching sequences. (6) The video concludes with the host delivering a promotional message in a high-energy, persuasive broadcast style. The music swells slightly toward the end. A final high-five or hand-clap sound effect accompanies their enthusiastic goodbye, marking a clean finish.
